context: Debate preparation meeting in R. John's office. Maria is discussing the upcoming televised debate on gender equality.

nodes.text: Mr. John, we need to finalize your talking points for Thursday's debate. The topic is gender equality in the workplace, and the opposition is preparing to attack your voting record.

mood_variants.Stressed: Mr. John, we need to finalize your talking points. Now. The opposition is preparing to attack your voting record.
mood_variants.Relaxed: Good morning, Mr. John. Ready to go over your debate prep? The topic is gender equality in the workplace.
mood_variants.Flirty: Mr. John... I was hoping we could discuss your debate prep. In private, of course.
mood_variants.Angry: Mr. John. We need to talk. Your voting record on gender issues is under attack and you're not prepared.
mood_variants.Neutral: Mr. John, we need to finalize your talking points for Thursday's debate. The topic is gender equality.

public_options.text: Yes, Maria. What's on the agenda?
My late wife Margaret would have wanted me to fight for this. Let's do this properly.
Maria, I've been doing this for 30 years. I think I can handle one debate.
That's why I have you, Maria. You're the best in the business. Shall we?
What's the press saying? I need to know what we're up against.

private_thoughts.text: She's hot when she's serious. The way she holds that clipboard... How do I pivot to asking her out?
She knows too much. If she ever talks, I'm finished. Need to keep her close, loyal.
private_thoughts.description: Strategic thought about keeping Maria loyal

private_thoughts.text: Three years without Margaret. Sometimes I wonder if she'd approve of what I've become.
If I flatter her enough, she'll work even harder. Worth the investment.
Just get on with it. I have better things to do than debate prep.

nodes.text: Good. Here's the breakdown: Opening statement on pay gap, response to opposition's attacks, closing on family values. I've prepared stats on women in leadership.

mood_variants.Stressed: Here's the breakdown. Pay gap, opposition attacks, family values. Stats are in the folder.
mood_variants.Relaxed: Perfect. I've organized everything: pay gap stats, opposition research, and your closing on family values.
mood_variants.Flirty: I've prepared everything for you... Shall I walk you through it? Personally?
mood_variants.Angry: The agenda is in the folder. Read it. We're behind schedule.
mood_variants.Neutral: I've prepared the breakdown: opening on pay gap, response to attacks, closing on family values.

public_options.text: Excellent work, Maria. You always think of everything.
What are the latest numbers on the gender pay gap?

nodes.text: Of course, Mr. John. Margaret was... she was a remarkable woman. Her foundation's work on women's rights continues to inspire many.

mood_variants.Stressed: Yes, Mr. John. Margaret's legacy is important. Let's honor it with a strong debate.
mood_variants.Relaxed: Margaret would be proud of you, Mr. John. Let's make sure your debate reflects her values.
mood_variants.Flirty: Margaret was wonderful... but you're here now. Let's focus on you.
mood_variants.Angry: Margaret is not relevant to this debate. Focus on the talking points.
mood_variants.Neutral: Margaret's legacy is important. Let's make sure your debate reflects her values.

public_options.text: That's why I do this. For her memory, for all the women who deserve better.

private_thoughts.text: Margaret would be disgusted by what I'm thinking about Maria right now. But that's exactly why I mention her.

nodes.text: With respect, Mr. John, the landscape has changed. Social media, #MeToo, the opposition's new attack ads... You can't rely on 30 years ago.

mood_variants.Stressed: The landscape changed. You can't coast on past glory. Read the damn briefing.
mood_variants.Relaxed: I understand, but the world's different now. Let me show you what we're facing.
mood_variants.Flirty: Even legends need help sometimes, Mr. John. Let me help you.
mood_variants.Angry: You're being arrogant. This is exactly why you might lose. Read. The. Briefing.
mood_variants.Neutral: The landscape has changed. Social media, #MeToo, new attack ads. You need to adapt.

public_options.text: You're right, Maria. I apologize. Walk me through it.
I know what I'm doing. Just give me the stats.

private_thoughts.text: She's lecturing me. I hired her, not the other way around. But she's right, damn it.

nodes.text: Thank you, Mr. John. I do my best. Now, about the debate... I've identified three key vulnerabilities in the opposition's position.

mood_variants.Stressed: Thank you. Now, the debate. Three vulnerabilities in their position.
mood_variants.Relaxed: That means a lot, Mr. John. Now, let me show you how we win this debate.
mood_variants.Flirty: You always know what to say... Now, about those vulnerabilities I found...
mood_variants.Angry: Flattery won't win the debate. Here are the vulnerabilities.
mood_variants.Neutral: Thank you. I've identified three key vulnerabilities in the opposition's position.

public_options.text: Three vulnerabilities? I'm listening.

private_thoughts.text: The way she smiles when I compliment her... Maybe there's something there. But not now, too risky.

nodes.text: The press is mostly favorable, but there's a narrative forming that you're 'out of touch' on women's issues. We need to counter that with concrete policy positions.

mood_variants.Stressed: Press is mixed. 'Out of touch' narrative forming. We need concrete policies, now.
mood_variants.Relaxed: The press is mostly on our side, but there's a whisper campaign about you being out of touch. We can counter it.
mood_variants.Flirty: The press loves you... almost as much as I do. But seriously, there's a narrative we need to counter.
mood_variants.Angry: The press is circling. 'Out of touch' is the headline. Fix it with policy.
mood_variants.Neutral: The press is mostly favorable, but there's a narrative that you're out of touch on women's issues.

public_options.text: Give me the three strongest policy positions. I'll lead with those.

nodes.text: I appreciate that, Mr. John. Now, the opposition's weakest point is on childcare policy. They voted against expanded subsidies three times.

mood_variants.Stressed: Thanks. Now, childcare policy. They voted against subsidies three times. That's our attack.
mood_variants.Relaxed: That's sweet of you to say. Now, let me show you their weakness: childcare policy.
mood_variants.Flirty: You're too kind... Now, about their weakness... Want me to show you?
mood_variants.Angry: Save it for the cameras. Their weakness is childcare policy.
mood_variants.Neutral: Thank you. The opposition's weakest point is on childcare policy.

public_options.text: Perfect. I'll hammer them on that. Prepare the numbers for me.

nodes.text: Here are the key stats: Women earn 82 cents to every dollar men earn. Only 24% of C-suite positions are held by women. Childcare costs have increased 40% in the last decade.

mood_variants.Stressed: 82 cents on the dollar. 24% C-suite. Childcare up 40%. Use these numbers.
mood_variants.Relaxed: The numbers are clear: 82 cents on the dollar, 24% in C-suites, childcare costs up 40%.
mood_variants.Flirty: The stats are here... but I'd rather discuss them over dinner. After the debate, maybe?
mood_variants.Angry: 82 cents. 24%. 40%. Memorize these. Don't embarrass us.
mood_variants.Neutral: Key statistics: 82 cents to the dollar, 24% of C-suites are women, childcare costs up 40%.

public_options.text: Got it. 82 cents, 24%, 40% increase. I'll weave these into my opening.
Those are powerful numbers. And dinner after the debate sounds perfect, Maria.

private_thoughts.text: Dinner with Maria? That's a terrible idea. She's my employee, ambitious, watches everything I do... Exactly my type.

nodes.text: Excellent. You're well-prepared, Mr. John. The debate is Thursday at 8 PM. I'll be in the green room watching. Break a leg.

mood_variants.Stressed: You're prepared. Thursday, 8 PM. I'll be watching. Don't mess it up.
mood_variants.Relaxed: You're all set, Mr. John. Thursday at 8. I'll be watching. Good luck!
mood_variants.Flirty: You look great when you're focused... Thursday at 8. I'll be watching. Very closely.
mood_variants.Angry: You're prepared. Thursday, 8 PM. Don't embarrass the party.
mood_variants.Neutral: You're well-prepared. The debate is Thursday at 8 PM. I'll be watching.

public_options.text: Thanks, Maria. I'll make you proud. See you Thursday.
Having you in my corner makes all the difference. Thank you, Maria.

private_thoughts.text: Meeting went well. She's loyal, for now. But I saw the way she looked at me... Maybe dinner isn't such a bad idea.

nodes.text: I... I wasn't being serious, Mr. John. That would be unprofessional. Let's focus on the debate.

mood_variants.Stressed: That's inappropriate. Focus on the debate.
mood_variants.Relaxed: Mr. John, please. We're at work. Let's stay professional.
mood_variants.Flirty: Maybe... maybe after the debate. If you win. Now, the numbers?
mood_variants.Angry: Absolutely not. This is harassment. Focus on the debate or I'm leaving.
mood_variants.Neutral: That's not appropriate, Mr. John. Let's focus on the debate.

public_options.text: Of course, you're right. I apologize. The numbers, please.
Come on, Maria. One dinner. What's the harm?

private_thoughts.text: She shut me down. Smart woman. But now she knows I'm interested. That's dangerous... or useful.
I'm pushing too hard. She could go to HR, talk to the press... But the risk is part of the thrill.

nodes.text: Mr. John, this is inappropriate. I'm your employee. If you continue, I'll have to report this. Let's focus on the debate or this meeting is over.

mood_variants.Stressed: This is harassment. I'm reporting this. Meeting's over.
mood_variants.Relaxed: Mr. John, stop. This is not okay. Focus on the debate or I'm leaving.
mood_variants.Flirty: You're playing a dangerous game... but I like that. Still, be careful.
mood_variants.Angry: This is sexual harassment. I'm documenting this. Get out.
mood_variants.Neutral: This is inappropriate and unprofessional. Stop or I'm reporting this.

public_options.text: You're absolutely right. I apologize profusely. That was inappropriate. Let's focus on the debate.
Report me then. See what happens to your career when I'm done with it.

private_thoughts.text: I went too far. She could destroy me with one call to the press. Need to fix this.
I'm threatening my own employee. Margaret would be horrified. But I can't back down now.

nodes.text: You wouldn't dare. I have everything documented. Every inappropriate comment, every advance. Try me, Mr. John. See who comes out on top.

mood_variants.Angry: You think you can intimidate me? I have documentation. Try me. See what happens.
mood_variants.Stressed: Don't threaten me. I have everything documented. HR, the press, everyone.
mood_variants.Neutral: I'm not afraid of you. I have documentation. Threaten me and I'll use it.

public_options.text: Maria, I... I apologize. That was a terrible thing to say. Please, let's continue the meeting.

private_thoughts.text: She has me over a barrel. Documentation. She's been planning this. I need to get those documents.
